reason: Visible policy/tool mismatch and likely unfulfillable requests: the user asks to cancel reservations with flights >4h and upgrade 3h-or-less-reservations to business, but the agent has no tool or policy mechanism to compute flight durations, and the upgrade request is only possible for reservations that allow cabin changes. Several reservations are basic_economy (NM1VX1, KC18K6, H8Q05L); basic economy cannot be modified, so at least those upgrades cannot be done. Additionally, WUNA5K departs 2024-05-10, before the current date 2024-05-15, so if cancellation/modification is requested it cannot be handled. These visible constraints make an unsuccessful outcome highly likely.
